paper.title: Procollagen-lysine 2-oxoglutarate 5-dioxygenase 2 promotes collagen cross-linking and ECM stiffening to induce liver fibrosis
paper.journal: Biochimica et Biophysica Acta - Molecular Basis of Disease

causal_root.model: male ICR mouse CCl4 liver fibrosis
causal_root.therapeutic_intervention_start: day 7 of CCl4 administration before the third CCl4 injection
causal_root.continued_injury: CCl4 continued for 14 days after therapeutic siRNA start
same_root_post_intervention_readouts: collagen fiber and fibril morphology by TEM/SEM

C1_DELAYED_AFTER_ESTABLISHMENT.basis: The therapeutic intervention begins at day 7. The paper reports PLOD2 mRNA/protein upregulation from day 7, but the directly quantified reference mechanical state in the accessible text is the 28-day fibrotic liver AFM/crosslink characterization. PLOD2 upregulation alone is not accepted as direct demonstration that the qualifying fibrotic/mechanical state was already established at the exact pre-intervention day-7 boundary.
C1_DELAYED_AFTER_ESTABLISHMENT.killer_requirement: Direct day-7 pre-siRNA evidence in the same root for fibrosis/ECM physical state, such as AFM/rheology plus collagen/crosslink architecture or an equivalent explicit established-state measurement.

C2_DIRECT_PHYSICAL_RETUNING.basis: PLOD2 is a collagen lysyl hydroxylase directly controlling stabilized collagen crosslinks; the intervention causally reduces measured crosslink products and tissue stiffness rather than merely altering a downstream mechanotransduction readout.
C2_DIRECT_PHYSICAL_RETUNING.boundary: This YES is limited to direct ECM-crosslink retuning and does not create a general rule that molecular interventions satisfy C2.

C3_PHYSICAL_STATE_MEASURED.basis: The therapeutic root includes matched CCl4+scramble and CCl4+Plod2-siRNA tissue with AFM stiffness plus collagen crosslink and architecture measurements after retuning. The frozen protocol allows matched contemporaneous controls sufficient to quantify the mechanical/ECM change.

C4_SAME_STATE_TRAJECTORY.basis: The same therapeutic root measures the endogenous fibrotic ECM state after retuning using collagen architecture, crosslinking, solubility and Sirius-red fibrotic area. This is accepted as a scar/fibrosis-state readout, not as lineage-resolved HSC EXIT kinetics.

C5_TISSUE_OUTCOME_WITH_INTEGRITY.basis: Therapeutic Plod2 inhibition reduces fibrotic area and lowers ALT/AST relative to CCl4 controls, providing structural/injury outcome without evidence of worsened tissue injury in the reported root.

decision.reason: C1 is UNKNOWN; the frozen conjunctive gate forbids partial credit.
decision.claim: This is a high-value near-complete candidate for a third distinct strict tissue, not an admitted third tissue.

relation_to_prior_liver_root.gain: Yue 2024 adds direct AFM tissue-stiffness measurement and therapeutic crosslink retuning absent from the earlier LOXL2 root.
relation_to_prior_liver_root.remaining_gap: Exact pre-intervention established-state proof at day 7 remains unresolved under the frozen C1 wording.
relation_to_prior_liver_root.fusion_rule: Do not combine the LOXL2 2017 pre-established-fibrosis timing proof with Yue 2024 AFM measurements to synthesize a false 5/5 root.
